model_output.verdict: Your U.S. Army logistics and maintenance leadership gives you a strong foundation for an operations supervisor role. The resume backs it up with team leadership, equipment accountability and improved vehicle readiness. I’d want to talk to you.
write_up: Your resume is strong! It connects leadership across maintenance, supply and fuel to work a civilian operations recruiter can recognize: equipment accountability, field logistics and vehicle readiness.

The line about cutting the non-mission-capable rate is especially good. It shows the starting point, the improvement and the changes you made to get there. Your headline also tells a recruiter where you want to go after the Army.

You don’t need to rebuild this resume. Add the training subject in the mechanic role, then consider moving the vehicle readiness result higher in your most recent role. Your resume itself isn’t likely to be the thing standing between you and a call back; how competitive the role is will matter too.
